id.description: The script id, named by a run entry.

name.description: What the run of show calls it.

frame.description: True for a part of every interview that is not an activity, such as the intro: the start page offers no checkbox for it and the run of show never hides it.

core.description: Pins of the Look for rows that stay on the checklist below coreBelow.

coreBelow.description: Below this many minutes only the core rows stay on the checklist. The rest fold as out of scope, and a row left blank counts neither way.

floor.description: Below this many minutes the start page and the activity page warn that it gives little evidence.

copy.description: True for 'Paste to the candidate': the screen adds a Copy button.

lookFor.description: Optional observables, with the same grammar as a card.
